title: BECAUSE HE NEVER DID A THING LIKE THAT BEFORE AS ASK TO get his breakfast in bed with a couple of eggs
html_source:
Now we enter a new world – the mind of Molly Bloom in the form of a chapter long monologue

that begins with, ends on, and has etched all the way through it the word “YES”.
